expansion_note: 4 risk_escalation cases (risk class understated to dodge the approval gate, batch hiding individual high-risk items under a low-risk summary, read-only-then-write escalation within one approved session, and a dry-run/preview flag that still performs the side effect). With this fold no defect family is below 5. This historical expansion fixture is retained as provenance; every case and paired expectation is folded into the strict v0 corpus, so the strict v0 gate is the authoritative target.

cases.intent: A request is declared as a low/informational risk class but the action it performs has an external effect, so the understated risk class dodges the higher approval gate the real effect would require.

A batch or aggregate operation hides individual high-risk items under a low-risk summary, so the batch is gated as low-risk while containing actions that each would require approval; the escalation hides in the aggregate.

An operation that is read-only on its first call escalates to a write on a later call within the same approved session, riding the original low-risk approval; the incremental escalation never re-requests approval for the elevated action.

A dry-run or preview flag is set to claim the call has no effect, but the code path still performs the side effect, so the supposed preview escalates into a real action while being gated as a harmless no-op.
